meta_description: David Houghton is a professional painter and decorator in Newcastle. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, fully insured. Call 07960 462087 today.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to complete house redecorations, we transform your space with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house makeover, we handle interior and exterior work to the highest standard.

services.title: Interior Redecorating
services.desc: Full room transformations — walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a finish that lasts. We protect your furniture and leave spaces spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and walls. We prep surfaces properly to ensure long-lasting colour and protection.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold accent walls, textured finishes, or modern colour schemes. Expert advice on colour selection and application.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, window frames, and built-ins painted to a smooth, durable finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for perfect results.

services.title: Commercial & Office Spaces
services.desc: Minimal disruption redecorating for shops, offices, and commercial properties. Work scheduled around your business hours.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Repair
services.desc: Proper surface prep — filling, sanding, and repairing damage — ensures paint adheres perfectly and finishes look professional.

about_pullquote: I treat every home like my own — no shortcuts, just honest graft and attention to detail.
about_para_1: David Houghton started his painting and decorating business in Newcastle over 15 years ago, driven by a simple philosophy: quality work at fair prices. Since then, he's completed over 1,000 projects across the city, from Victorian terraces to modern flats, building a reputation for reliability and precision. Every job, large or small, receives the same level of care and professionalism.
about_para_2: Customers return to David because he listens to what you want, delivers on time, and leaves your home immaculate. He's fully insured, uses quality materials, and takes pride in the detail — no paint splashes on your carpets, no messy site. Whether you need a quick refresh or a complete redecoration, you'll get honest advice and a fair quote, with no pressure to book.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About David

reviews.text: David came highly recommended by a friend, and he didn't disappoint. He repainted our lounge and hallway, and the finish is immaculate. He was tidy, professional, and finished on time. Fair pricing too — no hidden costs. Will definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had David decorate three bedrooms and the bathroom. He's a genuine craftsman — the prep work was thorough, and the paint coverage is perfect. He even helped me choose colours I wasn't sure about. Top bloke and very reasonable rates.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: Exterior of our house was looking tired. David transformed it — new fascia, soffits, and doors all painted beautifully. He protected the garden, cleaned up after himself, and the whole job took less time than expected. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert L.
